import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
credit_fraud = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Convert is_fraud column to categorical
credit_fraud['is_fraud'] = pd.Categorical(credit_fraud['is_fraud']).codes

# Create a bar plot to compare transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=credit_fraud)
plt.title('Transaction Types Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to analyze amount and hour_of_day
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', data=credit_fraud)
plt.title('Amount vs Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Amount')
plt.legend(title='is_fraud')
plt.savefig('output_scatter.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
